identity.definition: A cosmetic ingredient made from filtered snail secretion. Its composition varies with source and collection or extraction method.

label_terms.rule: Teach viewers to read the exact product ingredient list. Do not assume every snail-derived formula is the same extract, concentration, or evidence-backed preparation.

identity_boundaries: The consumer category is broader than the specific SCA extracts used in the small human trials.
A source-snail image explains origin; it does not prove collection conditions or animal welfare.
Named components such as allantoin or glycolic acid do not justify assigning the finished filtrate a specific medical mechanism.

visual_system.actor: A clear, elastic gel strand that stretches, gathers, and settles slowly.
visual_system.tactile_signature: Long stringy pull, small trapped bubbles, glass-like highlights, controlled viscosity.
motion_grammar: Use one slow stretch or pour as the recurring recognition cue.
Prefer macro pushes, refraction, and controlled settling over bouncing droplets.
Keep the snail, filtrate, formula, and skin application as separate visual states.

avoid: claiming this is a standardized chemical sample
assets.notes: Strong canonical clean-ground image with generous negative space.

avoid: adding benefit labels directly onto the strands

assets.notes: Label on-screen as an authored reenactment or illustrative process plate.

avoid: adding a fake percentage without a photographed label
assets.notes: New pilot asset; generated with the built-in image tool and validated to contain a real alpha channel.

components.purpose: Name the consumer term, show the preferred label term, and make formula specificity explicit.
Show study type and scope without converting a small trial into a verdict.
Show that measured composition changes with collection or extraction method.

evidence_records.claim: One controlled 1999 trial reported improvement in erythema, itching, and burning pain in acute radiodermatitis with a specific Cryptomphalus aspersa secretion preparation.
evidence_records.scope: acute radiodermatitis; n=100; one older trial
limits: not evidence for every snail-mucin formula

citation.title: Treatment of acute radiodermatitis with Cryptomphalus aspersa secretion

evidence_records.claim: A small randomized split-face trial found improvement in periocular rhytides after 12 weeks with one specific branded snail-secretion filtrate regimen.
evidence_records.scope: photoaged skin; n=25; specific SCA products
limits: participants did not report a significant skin-quality difference

citation.title: The Effects of Filtrate of the Secretion of the Cryptomphalus Aspersa on Photoaged Skin

evidence_records.claim: A randomized vehicle-controlled trial found both groups improved in fine lines and wrinkles; the active snail-filtrate plus snail-egg regimen showed additional changes in several secondary measures.
limits: authors called for larger randomized studies

citation.title: Efficacy and Safety of a New Cosmeceutical Regimen Based on the Combination of Snail Secretion Filtrate and Snail Egg Extract to Improve Signs of Skin Aging

evidence_records.claim: Four commercial snail secretion filtrates measured 97.5–99.2% water, and their measured composition differed with extraction method.
evidence_records.scope: four commercial filtrates from three Italian retailers
limits: does not establish a consumer skin benefit
does not independently verify animal welfare

citation.title: Influence of the extraction method on functional properties of commercial snail secretion filtrates

evidence_records.claim: No supporting study was located for the warning that applying a humectant to dry skin pulls hydration from deeper layers.
limits: absence-of-evidence statement based on the documented search
do not reverse it into a new efficacy claim

citation.title: Project claim ledger and explicit evidence search

safe_default: Snail mucin is a consumer term for filtered snail secretion used in cosmetics.
The measured composition can vary with collection and extraction method.
A few small studies tested specific preparations; that is not proof for every product.
Follow the directions and ingredient list on the actual product.
requires_context: Over 97% water — show the four-filtrate 2024 scope.
Fine-line improvement — name the specific trial, size, duration, and extract limitation.
Cruelty-free — attribute the claim to the company; do not present it as independently verified.
Damp-skin application — present only as a texture preference, not a proven hydration mechanism.

story_slots.purpose: Connect the familiar name to the product label.
Explain animal origin and why method matters.
Show promising but formula-specific human evidence.
Show application while preserving the evidence boundary.

format_input.boundary_card: Specific extracts have limited human data; do not treat every snail-mucin formula as equivalent.

legacy_quarantine.reason: Reference layout only. Its simplified component and benefit claims should not become pack defaults without claim-by-claim sourcing.
